name: Secure
text: Mission action. Mark an objective the active operative controls as secured by your team; it stays yours until the enemy secures it. Not in the first turning point.

name: Loot
text: Mission action. Loot an objective the active operative controls, unless anyone already looted it this turning point. Not in the first turning point.

name: Initiate Transmission
text: Mission action. An objective the active operative controls transmits until the start of the next turning point. Not in the first turning point.

name: Ammo Resupply
text: Use one of your Ammo Caches the operative controls: until the next turning point it may re-roll one attack die whenever it shoots with a datacard weapon. Each cache once per turning point.

name: Stun Grenade
text: Throw a stun grenade at a visible enemy within 6 inches; it and everything within 1 inch of it tests on a D6 and loses 1 APL on a 3 or more until the end of its next activation.

name: Smoke Grenade
text: Drop a smoke marker within 6 inches that is visible or on a visible Vantage part. Operatives wholly in the 1 inch cloud are obscured to those more than 2 inches away; the cloud clears after D3 activations of the next turning point.

name: Move With Barricade
text: An operative connected to the inside of a Portable Barricade moves at most its Move minus 2 inches with it, then sets the barricade up connected again.
